name: pull_request_read
description: Read one Origin-hosted pull request through a single view: summary, files, commits, reviews, comments, or threads. view defaults to summary. Summary includes labels, requested reviewers, and stack membership (stack id and parent pull request) when the pull request is stacked. The summary, reviews, and comments views carry authorDisplayName and authorHandle beside the opaque author id when Origin resolves them, so say the name rather than the id; a requested reviewer carries displayName and handle when Origin resolves them, and a group's are its name and organization/slug from the repository's reviewer roster, so a group missing from the roster is a bare grp_… id. A pull request, review, or comment a user authored through an app or service account keeps the user as author and adds that app_… or sa_… id and name as authorPerformedVia and authorPerformedViaDisplayName when Origin has them. The files view carries versionNumber and headSha, the pull request version its files and patch are the diff of. The threads view pages comments grouped by thread: every thread on the pull request, or only those in threadIds. pageSize counts comments, so a thread can continue on the next page; join its parts by id. Comments and threads carry url, a cursor.com link to that thread or comment on the pull request page. Images and recordings pasted into the description, a review, or a comment appear as cursor.com user-attachments URLs, and a cloud agent's screenshots and recordings as cursor.com artifact links; fetch one with get_pull_request_attachment.

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

view.description: summary (default), files, commits, reviews, comments, or threads

threadIds.description: Thread ids to limit the threads view to; omit for every thread
